Name: Spursy Animals
Author: JackManning
Description:
This mod simply alters some animal Sprite-sheets to make the animals look Spursy (Like Tottenham Hotspur Fans).
Currently this mod alters the sprites of:
Brown Chicken
BabyBrown Chicken
White Chicken
BabyWhite Chicken
Void Chicken
BabyVoid Chicken
Rabbit
BabyRabbit
Brown Cow
BabyBrown Cown
White Cow
BabyWhite Cow

Downloads.Description: Updated to 1.1.0: Adds sprites for all Cows
